findings.claim: The required PageCacheReused validation, isolation, no-I/O, and bounded fail-open characterization matrix is incomplete.
findings.observed: The supplied focused test covers basic completed/failed roundtrips, changed-payload idempotence, selected invalid values, and a pure Decimal mapping, but contains no cache-event tests for run/attempt/page/document isolation, omitted required-argument TypeError behavior, constructor cache/model/S3/environment sentinel checks, complete forbidden payload fields such as blocks/tables/storage keys, or the real existing file_received fail-open seam and its explicitly bounded responsibility.
findings.rationale: These are named deliverables of goal-001 rather than optional suite breadth; their absence leaves the requested cache contract proof materially incomplete even though the central event implementation already exists.
findings.required: Add focused hermetic PageCacheReused tests for every missing matrix branch, including exact missing-argument exception semantics, scoped isolation, full payload non-leakage, constructor no-I/O sentinels, and an honest concrete reference or characterization of the existing file_received-only fail-open boundary without inventing a cache producer API.
